title: Carry the Scenario seam verdict onto the map it gates when applied
instrument: component test: Scenario result with seam.hasSeam=true -> click Use as material -> assert the albedo slot carries a seam label in the editor and UE5ExportPanel/BlenderSendReport name it; plus an A/B on whether apply should block, confirm or only label
evidence:
src/components/modules/visual-gen/material-lab/AdvancedTexturePanel/useAdvancedTexturePanel.ts:71 applyMap -> setTexture(channel, url) with no seam field
src/components/modules/visual-gen/material-lab/AdvancedTexturePanel/useAdvancedTexturePanel.ts:84 applyAllMaps same
src/components/modules/visual-gen/material-lab/AdvancedTexturePanel/index.tsx:138 Use as material disabled={!anyMap} only - enabled over a detected seam
registry game-production/tiling-texture-acceptance: the check must gate the texture before engine import
body:
## Summary
A Scenario albedo flagged with a seam can be applied to the material, and the seam verdict is dropped at the hand-off, so the editor, Blender send and UE export never mention it.

## Description
The Advanced panel runs and shows the wrap-around seam check (index.tsx seam badge), but applyMap/applyAllMaps (src/components/modules/visual-gen/material-lab/AdvancedTexturePanel/useAdvancedTexturePanel.ts:71,78) call setTexture(channel,url) with nothing about the seam, and "Use as material" (src/components/modules/visual-gen/material-lab/AdvancedTexturePanel/index.tsx:138) stays enabled over hasSeam. The store's textureProvenance has no seam dimension. Per game-production/tiling-texture-acceptance the verdict must accompany the texture into the engine step; today it ends at the badge.

## Flow
- Generate a Scenario set whose albedo comes back hasSeam=true
- Click Use as material
- Editor slot shows the map with no warning; UE5 Export lists no caveat
- Fix: store a per-slot acceptance verdict (seam: pass/fail/unchecked) set by applyMap; render it on the slot and in both export reports; decide by A/B whether a failing tile is blocked, confirmed or labelled

## Expected impact
Designers stop shipping visibly seamed tiles to UE without a warning; measured by the count of downstream surfaces naming the seam (0/3 today). Could break: existing Advanced tests that assert the apply flow.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - a failing seam verdict is visible wherever the map goes
Before: 0 of 3 downstream surfaces (editor slot, Blender report, UE export) carry the seam verdict; apply enabled on hasSeam
After: predicted 3/3 surfaces name it
Method: simulation - walked the apply path in code; the block-vs-label decision needs an A/B, so no probe was taken
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: policy-tighten

title: Run the seam check on maps uploaded in the Editor tab
instrument: test that uploads a deliberately seamed fixture PNG to the Albedo slot and expects a seam verdict on the slot (1/3 entry paths produce a verdict today: Scenario only); the check must stay local, no provider
evidence:
src/components/modules/visual-gen/material-lab/PBREditor.tsx:101 URL.createObjectURL(file); setTexture(channel, url) - no check
grep -rln seam-check src/app/api -> src/app/api/scenario/route.ts, src/app/api/texture-maps/route.ts
src/components/modules/visual-gen/material-lab/useMaterialStore.ts DeriveMapsOutcome has no seam field
body:
## Summary
Only Scenario-generated textures get the wrap-around seam check; an albedo uploaded in the Editor tab is never checked, so the lab previews and exports it unverified.

## Description
Seam detection lives in lib/visual-gen/seam-check and is called from /api/scenario. TextureSlot uploads (src/components/modules/visual-gen/material-lab/PBREditor.tsx:101) go straight into the store. The tiling-texture-acceptance golden path says the check is arithmetic and should be mandatory before engine import; here it covers one of three entry paths (Scenario, upload, derive). Fixed = the free local check runs on albedo upload and the slot shows pass/fail/unchecked.

## Flow
- Upload a non-tiling photo as Albedo
- Preview + UE export accept it; no check runs
- Fix: on albedo upload, POST bytes to a local seam-check endpoint (or reuse /api/texture-maps), store the verdict, render it beside the ProvenanceChip

## Expected impact
Users who bring their own textures get the same seam signal Scenario users get; entry paths with a verdict 1/3 -> 3/3. Could break: upload latency; must never call a paid provider.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - every albedo entering the lab has a tiling verdict
Before: 1 of 3 entry paths (Scenario) yields a seam verdict
After: predicted 3/3
Method: simulation - traced the three entry paths; needs a fixture-based instrument
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none

body:
## Summary
Seven arbitrary 10-11px text sizes in TileError and the Advanced panel sit under the repo-enforced 12px legibility floor; TileError also fades its raw error line to red-300/50.

## Description
The repo lint rule flags each (WCAG 1.4.4: use text-xs, or MicroLabel/TEXT_SCALE for justified dense meta). TileError now renders all five Advanced tile errors (commit c26718e7), so its sizes cover more surface than before. Fixed = text-xs for body copy, MicroLabel/text-2xs only for justified dense meta, and an AA-contrast colour for the raw error line.

## Flow
- Trigger any Advanced tile failure
- Headline renders at 11px, raw error at 10px at 50% opacity
- Fix: swap to TEXT_SCALE tokens, re-run eslint, screenshot the badges

## Expected impact
Error and status copy readable at default zoom; lint warnings 7 -> 0. Could break: badge layout in the 3-column PBR thumbnail grid.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - error/status text meets the 12px floor
Before: 7 legibility-floor lint warnings across the two files
After: 0 predicted (lint is the gate)
Method: gate - eslint counts both sides; routed B because the visual change wants a screenshot A/B outside this round's gates
Result: better
Gate: none

title: Announce the Send to Blender outcome through live regions
instrument: render EditorTab with MaterialPreview, ViewportPreview and BlenderConnectionBar mocked and blenderMCPStore connected; assert a pre-mounted role=status holds blender-send-report and the error has role=alert
evidence:
src/components/modules/visual-gen/material-lab/MaterialLabView.tsx:30 blender-send-report div - no role
src/components/modules/visual-gen/material-lab/MaterialLabView.tsx:112 sendError div - no role=alert
grep -c 'role=' src/components/modules/visual-gen/material-lab/MaterialLabView.tsx -> 0
body:
## Summary
After Send to Blender, the success report and the error both render as plain divs, so a screen-reader user hears nothing about what was sent, what was dropped or why it failed.

## Description
src/components/modules/visual-gen/material-lab/MaterialLabView.tsx has 0 role/aria-live attributes. The report is the panel's honesty mechanism (sent vs notSent) and it is silent to assistive tech. DeriveMapsButton got the same fix this round (48bc4e27). Fixed = an always-mounted role=status aria-live=polite wrapper around BlenderSendReport and role=alert on the error.

## Flow
- Connect Blender, click Send to Blender
- Report appears; nothing is announced
- Fix: wrap in a pre-mounted live region; the error gets role=alert

## Expected impact
Assistive-tech users hear the dropped-parameter list; announced outcomes 0/2 -> 2/2. Could break: nothing visual.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - send outcome announced
Before: 0 of 2 outcome surfaces (report, error) announced
After: predicted 2/2
Method: simulation - EditorTab needs three heavy children mocked (r3f Canvas, Blender viewport, connection bar) to render in jsdom; that harness is the instrument
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none

title: Log the material store's five failure returns
instrument: spy on logger.warn in a store test: deriveMapsFromAlbedo, loadPresets, addPreset, removePreset and sendToBlender each failing once -> 5 tagged warn calls (0 today)
evidence:
grep -c logger src/components/modules/visual-gen/material-lab/useMaterialStore.ts -> 0
grep -c logger src/components/modules/visual-gen/material-lab/AdvancedTexturePanel/useAdvancedTexturePanel.ts -> 6
src/components/modules/visual-gen/material-lab/useMaterialStore.ts:240,266,287,306,370 if (!result.ok) return result - no log
body:
## Summary
The Advanced panel logs every provider failure through logger.warn, but useMaterialStore returns its five failures (derive, load/save/delete preset, Blender send) to the UI with no log line, so a dismissed failure leaves no trace.

## Description
Pair: src/components/modules/visual-gen/material-lab/AdvancedTexturePanel/useAdvancedTexturePanel.ts logs each failure with a tagged prefix; src/components/modules/visual-gen/material-lab/useMaterialStore.ts has 0 logger calls across its 5 failure exits. Fixed = one logger.warn('[material-lab] <action>: <error>') per failure exit.

## Flow
- Stop Blender MCP, click Send to Blender
- Error shown, then dismissed; nothing in the log
- Fix: add tagged warns at each failure return

## Expected impact
Failures become visible in the app log for debugging; failure exits logged 0/5 -> 5/5. Could break: nothing.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - every store failure leaves a log line
Before: 0 of 5 failure exits logged (Advanced hook logs 5/5)
After: predicted 5/5
Method: simulation - counted exits; the logger-spy test is the S instrument not built this round
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
